name: Joyride
overview: On a journey under the scorching sun, a group of friends decides to hit the open road in a vibrant red convertible. What begins as a simple desert trip quickly transforms into a quest for adventure and new connections. As they travel along isolated highways surrounded by mountains and floating balloons, a relaxed atmosphere takes over the group. Between strategic stops and moments of fun under the blue sky, they explore the freedom of the road, strengthening bonds and enjoying every kilometer of this intensely cinematic experience.
